messages:
harper: Noticing jittery reconnects from EU mobile customers. Pattern: upstream keepalive interval (10s) vs proxy idle (12s) => occasional race where proxy RSTs instead of FIN -> clients do full init.

raj: Can you paste a minimal log?

harper: snippet:
```
proxy-eu | idle=12s send=RST conn=0x1a
edge     | saw upstream keepalive at 10s
client   | onclose code=1006 -> reconnect init
```

tanya: So misaligned timers cause hard closes. Short-term fix: accept duplicate resume-token for 30s and emit metric stream.reconnect.timer_race. Long-term: harmonize keepalive window across proxy/edge or prefer FIN.

raj: I can land a small server-side dedupe and add X-Resume-Attached header when we reattach. Also create grafana panel stream.reconnect.timer_race by region.

ops-bot: Deploy started: raj/recv-dedupe -> canary eu-1.

harper: Canary (4m): metric spiked (expected) but overall new-session rate for affected clients dropped ~65%. No CPU regressions.

tanya: Follow-ups: (1) RFC to align keepalive semantics (tanya) (2) console flag to hide transient reconnects in product dashboard (harper) (3) alert: stream.reconnect.timer_race > 40/min for a region -> page.

raj: Will push the dedupe to rolling once canary at 15m looks stable. Closing thread if no regressions.
